services.desc: From casting off and crew, to Captain and cocktails, we’re ready! Charter our sailboat and sail along the the sound with breathtaking views, history, sunsets and more. We will take care of it all, from playing music (when requested), to finding great spots to swim, the best views and docking the boat. Your only job is to relax and enjoy. Looking for the ultimate private boat charter experience? Look no further than our premium boat rental services. Our sailboat charters, boat cruises, and sunset dinner cruises are perfect for any occasion.
